detail: Offer for sale - Ashokkumar Haridas Lal and Jitendra Haridas Lal have informed the Exchange about an announcement with respect to offer for sale through Stock Exchange Mechanism for sale up to 30,00,000 shares of Shreeji Shipping Global Limited.
